name: Cypress Point Park Disc Golf Course

holes.name: Hole 1
holes.obstacleNotes: Dogleg left: the woods on the inside shut the straight line, so shape a hyzer around the bend.

holes.name: Hole 2
holes.obstacleNotes: Tall trees guard the middle; the open lane is right: start right and fade back left (hyzer).

holes.name: Hole 4
holes.obstacleNotes: Dogleg right: the inside corner is wooded; work an anhyzer (or forehand hyzer) round the bend.

holes.name: Hole 5
holes.obstacleNotes: Low bushes fill the left half of the fairway: keep it right or throw high over them.

holes.name: Hole 7
holes.obstacleNotes: Tall trees guard the middle; the open lane is left: start left and work back right (flex or anhyzer).

holes.name: Hole 8
holes.obstacleNotes: Dogleg left: the woods on the inside shut the straight line, so shape a hyzer around the bend.

holes.name: Hole 11
holes.obstacleNotes: A tight tree-lined corridor: low and straight, with little room to curve.

holes.name: Hole 14
holes.obstacleNotes: Dogleg right: the inside corner is wooded; work an anhyzer (or forehand hyzer) round the bend.

holes.name: Hole 17
holes.obstacleNotes: Dogleg left: the woods on the inside shut the straight line, so shape a hyzer around the bend. Out of bounds left (a creek bank): stay on the fairway side.

holes.name: Hole 18
holes.obstacleNotes: Dogleg right: the inside corner is wooded; work an anhyzer (or forehand hyzer) round the bend.

layouts.name: Short Pads
layouts.description: Real hole lengths and pars from UDisc layout 'Short Pads' (see docs/COURSE_SOURCES.md); positions and terrain are still approximate, not a surveyed map. Fairway bends, bushes, tree blockers, water and OB are invented shaping, not surveyed features of the real course.
